Name: Cell: emergence
Overview:
Against the "smart germs" of tomorrow's biowarfare, nanites will be our drone soldiers, but for how long?

Based on a 3D version of mathematician John Conway's "Game of Life," the game puts the player in a biological world that is uncannily alive.

Enter the fluid living world of Cell (built from "dynamic voxels") to witness the emergence of new life: YOU, a nanobot who shoots deadly colloids, builds defenses and supercharged weapons, deciphers enemy nanotech -- and, by design, learns.
